integrity: Original mathematical statement with its derivation and finite independent exact-arithmetic checks; classical polytope and network-incidence ingredients are cited. Unverified historical equivalence risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Full support of the measure on all directed Hamiltonian tours is essential. The claim concerns degree-one arc Walsh characters; equal determinants do not imply equal condition numbers. The covariance pseudo-determinant under general nonuniform weights is not simplified to a weight-free closed form. Equivalent older D-optimal-design or polyhedral restatements may exist.
title: Equal-volume Walsh coordinate bases on directed Hamiltonian tours
